name: Soft cheddar scramble
description: A comforting, protein-rich breakfast.
steps: Beat the eggs and grate the cheddar.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over low heat.
Add the eggs and stir gently until fully set. Fold in the cheese and serve hot.

name: Golden egg toast
description: Simple ingredients, a satisfying start.
steps: Cut a small circle from the centre of the bread.
Melt butter over medium-low heat and add the bread and cut-out.
Crack the egg into the hole. Cook gently, then carefully turn and cook until the egg is fully set.

name: Spinach and feta omelette
description: A little Mediterranean inspiration.
steps: Wash and finely chop the spinach. Beat the eggs.
Heat the oil and wilt the spinach. Pour in the eggs.
Scatter over crumbled feta. Cook gently until fully set, fold and serve.

name: Potato and cheddar skillet
description: A warm meal built around a favourite vegetable.
steps: Scrub the potato and cut into small cubes.
Heat oil in a lidded pan, add potato and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the measured water, cover and cook gently until tender, about 12 minutes.
Remove the lid to evaporate remaining water. Add grated cheddar and let it melt.

name: Crisp potato wedges
description: An easy oven side with no hidden extras.
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C. Scrub potatoes and cut into thin wedges.
Toss with the measured oil and salt. Spread on a baking tray.
Bake for 25–30 minutes, turning halfway, until tender inside and golden outside.

name: Creamy mashed potato
description: Comforting and economical.
steps: Peel and dice the potato. Place in a small saucepan with the measured water.
Simmer until tender, about 15–20 minutes, then drain.
Mash with butter and warm milk until smooth.

name: Potato and egg hash
description: A filling one-pan meal.
steps: Dice potato and onion finely.
Heat oil, add the vegetables and stir for 5 minutes.
Add the measured water, cover and cook gently until potatoes are tender.
Uncover, let excess water evaporate, add beaten eggs and stir until fully cooked.

name: Feta potato bowl
description: Warm potato meets tangy cheese.
steps: Scrub and cube the potato. Simmer in the measured water until tender.
Drain thoroughly and place in a bowl.
Toss with oil and crumble feta over the warm potatoes.

name: Vegetable soy noodles
description: Quick cooking with a savoury flavour.
steps: Slice the carrot and pepper thinly.
Cook plain dry noodles in the measured water according to the packet, then drain.
Heat oil in a pan and stir-fry the vegetables until tender.
Add noodles and soy sauce. Toss until hot throughout.

name: Egg fried noodles
description: A quick meal with a little extra protein.
steps: Cook plain dry noodles in the measured water according to the packet and drain.
Heat oil in a pan, add beaten egg and scramble until fully set.
Add the noodles and soy sauce. Toss until hot throughout.

name: Garlic spinach noodles
description: A simple vegetable-led bowl.
steps: Peel and mince one garlic clove. Wash and chop spinach.
Cook noodles in the measured water according to the packet and drain.
Heat oil gently, cook garlic briefly without burning, then wilt spinach.
Add noodles and toss until hot throughout.

name: Cheddar vegetable noodles
description: Creamy comfort for a busy evening.
steps: Grate the carrot and cheddar.
Cook noodles with the carrot in the measured water until tender, then drain.
Return to low heat. Stir in milk and cheddar until melted and hot.

name: Cheddar toastie
description: A crisp, golden classic.
steps: Spread butter on one side of each bread slice.
Sandwich grated cheddar between the unbuttered sides.
Toast in a pan over medium-low heat, turning carefully, until both sides are golden and cheese has melted.

name: Tomato feta toast
description: Bright flavour on a crunchy base.
steps: Wash and dice the tomato. Toast the bread.
Brush toast with the measured oil.
Top with tomato and crumbled feta. Serve immediately.

name: Savoury eggy bread
description: A practical way to use older bread.
steps: Beat egg and milk in a shallow bowl.
Briefly dip both sides of each bread slice into the mixture.
Melt butter in a pan and cook the bread on both sides until golden and the egg is fully cooked.

name: Cinnamon toast crunch
description: A quick sweet treat inspired by Le’taya’s favourites.
steps: Mix sugar and cinnamon. Cut bread into bite-size squares.
Melt butter in a pan over medium-low heat. Add bread and turn until crisp.
Sprinkle over cinnamon sugar, toss briefly and serve warm.

name: Warm milky tea
description: A familiar pause in a busy day.
steps: Boil the measured water and pour over the tea bag in a mug.
Steep for 3–4 minutes, then remove the tea bag.
Stir in the milk and enjoy. No sugar is assumed.

name: Carrot and potato soup
description: A small batch of comforting vegetable soup.
steps: Peel and finely dice the vegetables.
Heat oil in a saucepan and soften the onion.
Add potato, carrot, measured water and salt. Simmer for about 20 minutes until very tender.
Mash carefully in the saucepan for a chunky soup.

name: Tomato scrambled eggs
description: A simple, gently cooked skillet.
steps: Wash and dice the tomato. Beat the eggs.
Heat oil and soften the tomato for 3–4 minutes.
Add eggs and stir gently until fully set. Serve hot.

name: Spinach cheddar toast
description: A warm vegetable-and-cheese snack.
steps: Wash and chop spinach. Melt butter in a pan and wilt spinach.
Toast the bread and top with spinach and grated cheddar.
Place under a hot grill briefly until cheese melts; watch closely.
